decisions.reason: Links the ESM top-level import to the classic-script combo compile failure killing all 53 registrations; inner frame identifies the culprit file, wrapper names the innocent first-awaited typert-registry entry; ESM-only-in-classic-script scoping respected.

Bisects the patch insert rows, proposes per-bundle classic-script parsing (or equivalent static gates) to flag ESM, and fully describes ModuleLoader.load({id,factory}) with package-name id, host React via factory require, module.exports exposing apply and inject list.

Uses plugin-apply-error and bare registration to explain declaration ownership and unconstrained cross-entry apply order; shows ctx.slots.inject('settings.section', () => ctx.slots.register({name,id,order}, Component)) deferred form; registrant fields name/id/order (optional label/locale), never kind/scope.

Combo read and cached once at boot, edits/refresh do not rebuild; full host stop/restart per iteration, taskkill /PID /T /F for the port-holding orphan; EADDRINUSE attributed to old process, not packaging; refresh then verify plugin list.

Per-plugin classic-script validation at startup with real-culprit attribution at combo failure; authoring checklist covers loader factory, host React via require, inject/apply, deferred cross-entry slots, host restart and Windows tree cleanup.
